fields.description:
## Context / Problem

Every Copilot CLI session started in this checkout fails at load:

```
Failed to connect to MCP server "serena": failed to initialize MCP client: transport
failure during send initialize request: the server closed its input stream (broken pipe)
```

Two defects combine.

**Wrong scope.** `.mcp.json` declares exactly one server, `mcpServers.rebar`
(`tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py:107` indexes it). Serena lives only in
machine-local `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json`, so it loads in every directory on the host and is
invisible to the repo — against the precedent recorded at `docs/mcp-client-setup.md:84-88`
("Copilot CLI 1.0.83 loads workspace `.mcp.json` before `.github/mcp.json` and lets workspace
entries override user-level entries").

**A launcher that cannot run in Copilot's MCP sandbox.** That entry runs
`uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena start-mcp-server`. `uvx` re-resolves the
git ref and rebuilds on every launch; Copilot sandboxes MCP servers (`sandbox.sandboxMcpServers`
in `~/.copilot/settings.json`), and uv's build shells out to `git init`, which cannot read
`~/.gitconfig` inside that sandbox. From `~/.copilot/logs/process-1789493292635-48702.log`:

```
╰─▶ process didn't exit successfully: `/opt/homebrew/bin/git init` (exit status: 128)
    fatal: unable to access '/Users/joeoakhart/.gitconfig': Operation not permitted
```

uv aborts, the child never reads stdin, and the client sees a broken pipe on `initialize`. The
failure is deterministic, reproduced on every session start. `AGENTS.md` §"Navigating the
codebase" mandates Serena for semantic navigation, so while it is down every agent silently
degrades to `grep`.

## Approach

Point the entry at an already-installed binary, and move the entry into the project config.
`uv tool install --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena-agent` produces
`~/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/bin/serena` (confirmed on this host; serena-agent
1.7.1.dev0). That is what fixes the bug — it takes git and the network off the startup path, so
the sandbox never invokes `git init`. It fits better than any launcher that resolves a remote
ref because it is the only option whose startup is independent of upstream HEAD, so the server
cannot break again when HEAD moves; upgrades become a deliberate `uv tool upgrade serena-agent`.

Two verified facts make the entry safe to commit to a shared tracked file:

- Copilot expands `${HOME}` in both `command` and `args` of a project `.mcp.json`. Verified
  empirically, not assumed: a scratch project whose `command` was
  `${HOME}/scratch/mcp-probe/bin/probe.sh` logged `LAUNCHED
  cmd=/Users/joeoakhart/scratch/mcp-probe/bin/probe.sh args=start-mcp-server --context
  ide-assistant --project /Users/joeoakhart/.rebar-serena-mirror`.
- No sandbox policy change is required: `~/.local/share` and `~/.rebar-serena-mirror` are
  already in `sandbox.userPolicy.filesystem.readwritePaths`, and serena's only git call
  (`serena/util/git.py:get_git_status`) is wrapped in a bare `except:` returning `None`.

## Scope

- `.mcp.json` — add `mcpServers.serena` (`type: local`, command
  `${HOME}/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/bin/serena`, args `start-mcp-server --context
  ide-assistant --project ${HOME}/.rebar-serena-mirror`, `tools: ["*"]`); extend `$comment`
  with why the entry must not use `uvx --from git+`.
- `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` — in the existing `## Copilot CLI` section, document the entry, the
  one-time `uv tool install`, and the `~/.rebar-serena-mirror` prerequisite.
- `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py` — add one test.

The `.mcp.json` change is purely additive: the existing tests index `doc["mcpServers"]["rebar"]`
by key (lines 107-118), and `test_no_secret_committed` scans the file text for a
`Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=_.-]{16,}` literal, which a serena entry does not introduce.

Out of scope, being host actions rather than repository files: removing the stale user-level
entry with `copilot mcp remove serena`, and the per-developer `uv tool install`.

## Testing

`test_serena_entry_is_prebuilt_not_git_build`, reading the committed `.mcp.json`:

- Happy path: `type == "local"`, `command` ends with `/bin/serena`, `args` contain
  `start-mcp-server`.
- Regression path, encoding this bug: the serialized entry contains neither `uvx` nor `git+`,
  so restoring `command: "uvx"` with `args: ["--from", "git+https://github.com/oraios/serena",
  "serena", "start-mcp-server"]` fails the test.

This is a cutover of a live client integration, so a real headless `copilot -p` run is part of
acceptance rather than a unit test.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `.mcp.json` declares `mcpServers.serena` as `type: local` with command
      `${HOME}/.local/share/uv/tools/serena-agent/bin/serena`; checked by
      `pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py -k serena` exiting 0.
- [x] The committed entry contains neither `uvx` nor `git+`; checked by that test's regression
      assertion, demonstrated to fail when the entry is reverted to the uvx launcher.
- [x] Serena is workspace-scoped, not user-scoped: `copilot mcp list` from the repo root lists
      `serena` under `Workspace servers`, and from `$HOME` does not list it; checked by running
      both and pasting both outputs into a ticket comment.
- [x] A headless `copilot -p` run in this checkout initializes serena; checked by
      `grep -c "MCP server connection failed" <log>` printing 0 and
      `grep -q 'name: .Serena.' <log>` exiting 0, with the log path named in a ticket comment.
- [x] `docs/mcp-client-setup.md` names the one-time install; checked by
      `grep -q "uv tool install --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena-agent"
      docs/mcp-client-setup.md` exiting 0.
- [x] `[non-codebase]` The change is uploaded to Gerrit as a reviewable change; evidence is the
      change number and its `Change-Id`, recorded in a ticket comment. The pipeline is
      known-blocked this session, so `LLM-Review +1` / `Verified +1` and Submit are out of
      scope for this ticket.
